clips.title: The story
paras: On Teldrassil, a strange fruit glows beneath unusual fronds. Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth studies its strange reaction to the World Tree's soil.

The Glowing Fruit hangs beneath unusual fronds on Teldrassil, bright and round. Botanist Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth recognizes it as foreign to the World Tree. He thinks its seeds came from distant lands across the sea. Its reaction to Teldrassil's rich, enchanted soil shows how foreign plants can affect the young World Tree.
